beats.headline: The mystery meat at Hungry Eyes
beats.text: Hungry Eyes village, between heats. I am walking with Prepotente when we run into Carl and the cat, and there is a vendor doing mystery meat off a cart at the edge of the square. Prepotente tells me not to, at length. I have a sixth sense about these things, and I ask Heidi, and I eat it anyway. Two sticks. I would like that recorded as the least dangerous mistake I have made anywhere in this dungeon.

beats.headline: Crawler against crawler
beats.text: I have been sick on the sidewalk, and I am better now, mostly. What I want from Florin is Lucia: how she is, where she is, how she is acting. Then I say the serious thing. Come first in every race. And if it ever comes to crawler against crawler, tell me, and I will make certain the other team knows what they are up against, and what has to happen. I will make them understand.

beats.headline: Somebody has to answer for the children
beats.text: The bar fight is over and the nickels are still being picked up off the floor, and I cannot wait for Carl to finish his errand. There is a goddess threatening to kill all the children. He tells me the only thing to do from this side is talk Lucia into a deal. Then send me out, I tell him, the way the others will go. He says I cannot, because of the god I worship. So I tell him the rest. I used to be able to talk to Heidi, and I have not heard her in a while. She is pregnant. I have to get to her.

beats.headline: The axe does not come back
beats.text: A gorilla made of molten metal is on the wall in front of Sweety, in our way. I throw one of my battle-axes into it. It goes into the metal and it is gone, and the beast falls off the wall into the river, which is good. Then I hold my hand out for the axe to come back, the way it always comes back. It does not come back. So now I have one axe, and I am riding a tapir sideways along a wall, and I am still shouting.

beats.headline: Prepotente will not get back on Sweety
beats.text: Inside the apartment course, shrunk down small, and Prepotente has stopped. He is standing in front of a piano watching his mother play it and he has jumped off Sweety and will not get back on. I am not going to shout at a boy about his mother, and the air in that room is poison to me and I have one dose of what lets me breathe it, so I put out a call and Carl comes. Whatever these rooms are built from, they are not built from nothing, and they have been built for us specifically.

beats.headline: The crystal covers him
beats.text: Carl is a dachshund. Elle, Jacobus and Chris are transformed as well, and the reason I am still shaped like myself is Prepotente's Memorial Crystal, which covered him and covered me with him. He tells us it stands at eleven point one per cent charged. Eleven per cent of a thing I do not understand, and it is holding me in my own shape. Then the heat starts and I do as I am told.
